Name: Piper - A Pierre Rewrite
Author: Heliaxe
AuthorLabel: Created by Holychurros and Stanloona420 - Updated by Heliax
Description:
[size=4][b][size=4][b]If Pierre's antics have worn you thin, hopefully this mod will offer you the change you've been looking for![/b][/size] With Piper, you'll no longer have to deal with Pierres often rude and overall shady behaviors. You'll also no longer need to fret over a certain someone taking credit for your hard work. Instead, Piper is the kind of community figure who actually seeks to help, and lift others up! If that is something that interests you, feel free to give this mod a try!!![/b][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11283]
This mod was originally created by Holychurros and Stanloona420[/url], But I've taken over for future development for the foreseeable future![/size]
[size=3]
As for how my version differs:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]All mentions of Pierre in base game have been altered to Piper, Dialogue, Popup menus, the sign outside the general store, etc[/size]
[*][size=3]Events have been changed to better showcase her as a character. I've also rewritten the story between Piper and Caroline and how they came to be, however in a future update, I plan on allowing players to pick my rewrite, or the original creators' rewrite, as the more options the better in my opinion! [/size]
[*][size=3]Piper now has seasonal and event clothing, I came up with most designs, however [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS?gameId=1303]Airyn[/url]﻿ from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]DSV[/url]﻿ team cleaned up a lot of my work as I'm not the best when it comes to pixel art. Also, for Pipers Spirits eve costume, I chose to adapt Pierres costume from Poltergeisters [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]﻿, as in general her artwork was made with this mod in mind![/size]
[/list][size=5]
[b][color=#00ff00][u][center]Mod Compatibility: [/center][/u][/color][/b][/size]
[size=3]I've also added compatibility for a few mods, with more to come! But here's what will be available with my initial update:

[b][center]For dialogue:[/center]
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18657]Abigail's Event Expansion[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Ramodia[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18972]Immersive Family[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]﻿ and all of its addons [/size][size=2](except for the Bear Family, I was unable to reach the author)[/size][size=3], and I've also added some support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14426]GNMT[/url]﻿[/size]
[size=3][size=2]
Some events might look a tad jank, I'm still new to event creation, so I apologize if things look a tad basic, but nonetheless, Piper has fully replaced Pierre in all of the aforementioned mods[/size][size=3]
[/size]
[/size][/list][size=3]

And due to how certain dialogue works, I've had to implement [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens[/url] such that everything can work properly, please do not forget to download and endorse this mod! [/size][size=2](it's been a real life saver for me)[/size][size=3]


[b][center]For themes:[/center]
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14524]Elle's Town Buildings[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995]Wittily[/url]﻿[/size]
[size=3][size=3][/size][size=2]
In order to set your desired theme, do so via the mods config, either by using a mod like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ to make changes, or by manually altering the config file of the mod! (options for each setting will be visible at the top of the content file)[/size][/size][/list][size=5][u][b][color=#ffff00]
[/color][/b][center][b][color=#ffff00]Future Plans[/color][/b]:[/center][/u][/size]
[size=3]I have more mods in mind to add support for, however if you have any suggestions, I'll gladly add support for them in the next update I push out! I also plan on implementing multiple story options for those who may be looking for something different from the story I currently have written! I am equally open to suggestions as to potential paths you would like this mod to cover![/size][size=4][color=#ff0000][b] 
[/b][/color][color=#ff0000][b][size=5][u][b][color=#ffff00][size=3]
[/size][/color][/b][/u][/size]
[/b][/color][/size][center][color=#ff0000][size=5][b][color=#00ffff][b][u]Edits and Translations:[/u][/b][/color][/b][/size][/color][size=4][color=#ff0000][b][color=#00ffff][size=4][b][/b][/size][/color][/b][/color][/size][/center][size=4][color=#ff0000][b][color=#00ffff][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][/color][/b][/color][/size][size=3]If anyone wishes to alter this mod or make it compatible for other mods, feel free to do so!  As for things like translations, I can only really speak English fluently, so the chances of me getting around to translating to other languages is not likely. So if anyone is willing to translate this mod into other languages, that would be greatly appreciated![/size][size=4][color=#ff0000][b]

[/b][/color][/size][center][color=#ff0000][size=5][b][u]Any Bugs or Issues?[/u][/b][/size][/color][size=4][color=#ff0000][b][/b][/color][/size][/center][size=4][color=#ff0000][b]
[/b][/color][/size][size=3]If you find any broken lines, if there are mentions of Pierre I've missed, if events are scuffed, or if there are any issues my mod is responsible for, please feel free to report them! And I'll try to push out an update as fast as I can to address the issue![/size][u][size=5][size=4][color=#ff0000][b]
[/b][/color][/size]
[/size][/u][color=#ff00ff][u][size=5][b][center]Special Thanks:[/center][/b][/size][/u][size=4][b]

[/b][/size][/color][list]
[*][size=3]First and foremost, this mod would've not been possible if Holychurros and Stanloona420 had not created it, so to them I am forever thankful![/size]
[size=3]
[/size][*][size=3]I would like to give a huge thanks to Airyn from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]DSV team [/url]as he has helped me fix a few issues that were present on the initial version of my mod, and I would probably be unaware of a lot of things without his help. As well as for cleaning up a lot of my shoddy artwork 🤭 [/size]
[/list]
